kind: label-utilisation pilot on the frozen strongest body — NOT a new architecture and NOT an original mechanism
question: With the DCC-L / B-R0 body, forward, parameter count and recipe frozen, does a conservative train-only radius-2 structural-support weighting of the raw-y L1 objective improve official-valid performance?

arms.E: uniform raw-y L1 (historical R0 objective, unchanged)
arms.W: same objective, per-training-molecule weight w_i from train-only radius-2 support (see weights_frozen)
arms.E_anchor: zinc_dual_channel_composer_v1/runs/L_s0 (best 0.078537 @ep489) — reused as the frozen E checkpoint because its initial-state hash, SSL source, environment and recipe match exactly; a fresh E run is also executed as a drift control

weights_frozen.function: low4_i = frac of molecule i's atoms with 1<=c_h<=4 in the train-10k exact typed radius-2 signature vocabulary; z = clip((low4-mean)/std, -1, 1); w = 1 + 0.5*z; w /= mean(w)
weights_frozen.hypothesis_sign: rare-structure training molecules get MORE weight (declared before the run); a null or a loss also rules out the opposite reading because the two predict opposite signs

seeds.note: seeds >= 1 reuse pretrain_encoder_s1.pt exactly as zinc_performance_search_v1 did; this truncates initialisation diversity and must be stated whenever a multi-seed mean is quoted

decision_rules.PRIMARY: overall valid MAE over all 1000 rows, same seed, W vs E
decision_rules.PROCEED_TO_SEED1: W - E <= -0.003 AND radius2_low_support improves AND ordinary (y>-3) does not regress by more than 0.002
decision_rules.CONFIRM_EXTENSION: seed 0 and seed 1 agree in sign and the paired mean is <= -0.003
decision_rules.STOP_NO_EFFECT: -0.003 < W - E < +0.0025, or the sign flips across seeds
decision_rules.STOP_NEGATIVE: W - E >= +0.0025 on overall, or ordinary regresses by more than 0.002
decision_rules.NO_RESCUE: after the first pair, the weight function (lambda, clip, band, normalisation) is NOT re-tuned and no hyper-parameter is scanned

isolation.official_test: never constructed, loaded, predicted or scored
isolation.historical_results: read-only; the E anchor is reused, never modified
isolation.weight_design: frozen before any GPU run; sha256 recorded here and re-checked by the runner and the gates
